name: did-you-rtfm
description: Agent Skill plus two firewall hooks that interrupt the agent's pivot reflex on errors during user-authorized implementation work. The skill forces version checks, version-specific authoritative docs, assumption verification, stale-training-data sanity checks, and a minimal repro before any 'blocker' claim or unauthorized plan change. A Stop/SubagentStop hook blocks pivot-language phrases; a PreToolUse hook denies Bash bypass flags and TTY-faking workarounds. Plan changes are the user's decision.
